== Summary ==
Lossless original JPEG29 + transparency-mask28 composition from December 2022 errata PDF page3. [[:File:PC-Errata-December-2022.pdf|Official December 2022 errata sheet]], page 3. Exact display PNG and RGBA pixels recur in October2023 PDF page5 JPEG69/mask68; compressed mask streams differ, not appearance. Lucasfilm Ltd.; published by the Players Committee. Unknown first-publication days are not assigned.
